Container.Name: docker-craft-portal
Container.Overview: Self-hosted authenticated ArtCraft WASM portal. Release candidate: review the repository acceptance evidence before public deployment. REQUIRED: replace both example hostnames, configure HTTPS reverse proxy preserving Host, and prepare appdata ownership for UID/GID 10001. App code must use a different origin from the portal. This template is manually installed; it is not a Community Applications listing.

Config.Name: Portal port
Config.Description: Backend HTTP port. Restrict access to the trusted HTTPS reverse proxy; do not expose this port publicly.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Prepare this directory as UID/GID 10001 with mode 0700 before first start. Contains private database and downloaded app versions.

Config.Name: Portal HTTPS origin (REPLACE EXAMPLE)
Config.Description: Exact external HTTPS portal origin. Replace example.com and update the container WebUI field to this same URL in Advanced View.

Config.Name: Single-user app HTTPS origin (REPLACE EXAMPLE)
Config.Description: Different hostname from portal, proxied to the same backend. Replace example.com. Clear this value entirely when setting the multiuser wildcard domain.

Config.Name: Multiuser apps domain (optional)
Config.Description: Optional bare domain such as apps.example.com, without scheme or port. Requires wildcard DNS/TLS. MUST clear CRAFT_SINGLE_APP_URL when configured.

Config.Name: Enable scheduled updates
Config.Description: true enables startup discovery and the scheduled updater; false is for offline validation.

Config.Name: GitHub API token (optional)
Config.Description: Optional token for higher API limits. Leave blank unless needed. Masking hides the UI field, not Docker administrator access or saved Unraid template contents.
